high_level_description: The image shows the entrance to a WeWork office space. The glass door is partially open, and a person with their back to the camera is entering or exiting the building. The individual appears to be wearing a dark-colored jacket and has their hair tied up. The top of the door features a large, bold "WeWork" sign in black letters against a yellow background. Above the sign, there is an illuminated exit sign that reads "EXIT" in red letters. Below the door, there is a banner with the word "BREAKING" in white capital letters on a red background, indicating that the news is urgent or significant.
